vrcamera.message.novr: VR Camera: VR is not running
vrcamera.message.seated: VR Camera: not available in seated mode
vrcamera.config.title: VR Camera
vrcamera.config.presets.description: Shots placed by hand. Grab the camera in VR to place the active one, add and delete them in the pause menu.
vrcamera.option.forceMirror.tooltip: Shows the camera view in the game window while the camera is on. Applies the next time the camera is turned on.
vrcamera.option.marker.tooltip: What shows where the camera is, in the headset. Never visible in the recording.
vrcamera.option.markerLabel.tooltip: Shows the name of the current shot next to the dot.
vrcamera.option.debugOverlay.tooltip: Shows what the camera is doing and why, on the HUD.
vrcamera.option.aimHeight.tooltip: Where on the body the camera aims. 0 is the feet, 1 is the head.
vrcamera.option.positionLag.tooltip: How long the camera takes to reach its position. Higher is smoother and slower.
vrcamera.option.lookLag.tooltip: How long the camera aim takes to catch up with the player.
vrcamera.option.turnLag.tooltip: How long the camera takes to swing around when the player turns.
vrcamera.option.turnDeadzone.tooltip: How far the player can turn before the camera starts to move. Raise this if the camera swings around too much.
vrcamera.option.leadRoom.tooltip: Aims ahead of a moving player, to leave room in the frame where they are going. 0 aims exactly at the body.
vrcamera.option.leadRoomMax.tooltip: Most the aim moves away from the player, in player sizes.
vrcamera.option.orbitSpeed.tooltip: How fast the orbit shot circles the player.
vrcamera.option.speedFov.tooltip: Widens the view at high speeds.
vrcamera.option.collisionRadius.tooltip: How far the camera stays away from blocks.
vrcamera.option.collisionMargin.tooltip: Additional distance to a block that is in the way.
vrcamera.option.softOcclusionTime.toolti: How long the camera ignores something thin between it and the player, like a tree. 0 turns this off.
vrcamera.option.occlusionRatio.tooltip: The shot is replaced when walls push the camera closer than this part of its distance.
vrcamera.option.occlusionCutTime.tooltip: How long the camera has to be squeezed before the shot is replaced.
vrcamera.option.transition.tooltip: How the camera gets to the next shot. Cut jumps there, swing flies around the player.
vrcamera.option.blendChance.tooltip: Chance for a swing instead of a cut, with automatic transitions.
vrcamera.option.minShotTime.tooltip: A shot stays at least this long, before it is replaced because the situation changed.
vrcamera.option.manualHoldSeconds.toolti: How long the director keeps a camera that was placed by hand.
vrcamera.option.events.tooltip: Special shots for dying and for long falls.
vrcamera.option.customInRotation.tooltip: The director also picks the hand placed shots.
vrcamera.shot.field.enabled.tooltip: If the director may use this shot.
vrcamera.shot.field.weight.tooltip: How often this shot is picked, compared to the others.
vrcamera.shot.field.azimuth.tooltip: 0 is in front of the player, 180 is behind.
vrcamera.shot.field.elevation.tooltip: How high above the horizon the camera is, seen from the player.
vrcamera.shot.field.distance.tooltip: In blocks for a regular sized player.
vrcamera.shot.field.fov.tooltip: Field of view of the camera.
vrcamera.shot.field.minDuration.tooltip: The shot stays at least this long.
vrcamera.shot.field.maxDuration.tooltip: The shot stays at most this long.
vrcamera.shot.shoulder.tooltip: Behind the player, looking over their shoulder.
vrcamera.shot.front.tooltip: In front of the player, backing away. Moves in while they stand still.
vrcamera.shot.flyby.tooltip: Stands ahead on the path and pans while the player passes. Distance is how far ahead, the angles are not used.
vrcamera.shot.crane.tooltip: Rises high up behind the player.
vrcamera.shot.duel.tooltip: Over the shoulder onto the opponent, both in frame. The angle around is measured from the opponent.
vrcamera.shot.death.tooltip: Circles the dead player. Only shown when dying.
vrcamera.shot.fall.tooltip: From above. Only shown on long falls.
vrcamera.message.summon: VR Camera: in front of you, grab it and place it
vrcamera.message.error: VR Camera: internal error, camera turned off (see log)
vrcamera.command.nocloth: VR Camera: the settings screen needs Cloth Config
vrcamera.command.nopreset: VR Camera: no such preset, active is %s
vrcamera.shot.pov.tooltip: Right in front of the face, looking where the player looks. Used where there is no room for a camera around the player. Distance is how far in front of the eyes, the angles are not used.
vrcamera.shot.menu.tooltip: Close over the shoulder onto an open menu: inventory, chest, pause menu. Only shown while one is open. The angle around is measured from the menu, lower it to see more past the shoulder.
vrcamera.option.indicator.tooltip: Shows a camera icon with the distance in the headset, where the camera is, also through walls. While the camera is out of sight the icon sticks to the edge of the view on that side. Never visible in the recording.
vrcamera.option.throwPower.tooltip: The camera can be grabbed and thrown, a faster throw goes further. This sets how far. 0 turns throwing off.
vrcamera.option.physicsAim.tooltip: In the physics mode: how much a dropped camera turns its lens to the player while it comes to rest. 0 leaves it lying however it fell, 1 makes it look right at the player.
vrcamera.option.indicatorSize.tooltip: Size of the camera icon and of the distance below it.
vrcamera.option.physicsShake.tooltip: In the physics mode: how much a camera held in the hand sways with breath and steps, and jolts when you get hurt. 0 keeps it as steady as the hand.
vrcamera.option.pullSeconds.tooltip: Look at the camera from afar, point a hand at it and hold the interact button. The controller buzzes harder and harder, and after this many seconds the camera flies into the hand. 0 turns pulling off.
vrcamera.option.pullAllModes.tooltip: Off: the camera can only be pulled in the physics mode. Turn it off if the hand catches the camera by accident while it films you from the front.
